headline: Presidents Cup Day 3 at Medinah: USA and Internationals battle through 8-point moving day
whyCareReason: Moving Day at Medinah Course No. 3 features a marathon double session with 8 points at stake across morning four-balls and afternoon foursomes.
teaser: Saturday 26 September on Medinah No. 3: morning four-balls followed by afternoon foursomes. Snedeker's USA battles Ogilvy's Internationals for 8 pivotal points.
story:
Why this one matters: Saturday 26 September is the definitive moving day at the 16th Presidents Cup on Medinah Country Club's Course No. 3 in Illinois.

PGA Tour and PresidentsCup.com outline the grueling schedule: four morning four-ball matches followed immediately by four afternoon foursomes matches. With eight total points on offer before Sunday singles, Saturday historically decides the cup.

Captains Brandt Snedeker and Geoff Ogilvy sent out their strongest duos. World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler partners Collin Morikawa in morning four-balls against Adam Scott and Min Woo Lee. Patrick Cantlay and Xander Schauffele face Hideki Matsuyama and Sungjae Im. On Medinah's treacherous OCM-redesigned greens, endurance and lag putting will prove decisive.
stakes: Eight points available on Saturday alone. The team emerging from Medinah's double session with the lead has won 14 of 15 previous Presidents Cups.
rivalryAngle: Team USA dominance versus International determination on Chicago's most famous championship stage.
